result.title: Strong Starts, Simple Recipes: Unified Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation from Multimodal Specialists
result.comment: Project page, code, and model weights: https://amberheart.github.io/Uni-MOPD/
result.summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) integrates separately trained domain specialists into a single unified model. Existing methods focus on refining the distillation procedure while initializing the student from a base model or a multi-domain SFT checkpoint, which leaves capability integration largely to distillation itself. Instead, we treat the starting point as a design variable and propose Unified MOPD (Uni-MOPD), which pairs a strong start with a simple recipe: a training-free uniform merge of specialists from the same base model initializes the student, and short MOPD with uniform domain sampling and full-vocabulary reverse KL refines it. Across five multimodal domains and 19 benchmarks, our study establishes three findings. (1) The starting point matters more than subsequent training choices: before any training, the uniform merge already matches the score that the base model reaches after 200 MOPD updates, and after short distillation it matches higher-scoring, search-based starts. (2) Short MOPD recovers most of the capabilities the merge leaves unintegrated; it improves every domain, with the largest gains where the domain teacher still leads. (3) From a strong start, uniform domain sampling and full-vocabulary reverse KL match or exceed every evaluated sampling strategy and divergence, without schedules, per-token weighting, or truncation hyperparameters. Uni-MOPD outperforms Open-MOPD at the same training budget while training 3.3 times faster than its released code. We will release the training framework, specialist checkpoints, and unified student.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Uni-MOPD：以同源多领域专家的均匀权重合并作为学生初始化，再用短程多教师 on-policy 蒸馏（均匀领域采样、全词表 reverse KL）整合五个多模态领域能力，并在 19 个基准上比较不同起点与训练配方。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「起点比训练配方更关键」的结论及多教师蒸馏中的贡献分配，可能为 LVR 训练监督、专家合并与监督信号有效性提供核查线索，但论文不涉及 latent 推理状态，迁移性需较多验证。
